_comment: What an inflicted meteor storm costs an Age's instability budget, dial by dial (design 5.0, 5.2).
Difficulty you can answer: anything in `agesandtheart:seals_wounds` is immune to a blast worth using,
and being properly indoors is free. So two of its three dials are cheap, as the deluge's are: `often` is
how often a storm gathers and `long` how long it lasts, and how many bodies it drops follows `long`
alone, since every body is a light drawn in the sky. `power` is how hard they land -- speed and blast --
which is what can take a roof off, and it is dear. A dial bought in full is worth what `teeming` is to a
written storm. All three open at 16 with the other phenomena. Every number here waits on the tuning pass.
